subject: NULL address pointer and message tag content
notes: 'When associated with a function-pointer, the predefined address NULL references a data item of category function-pointer that contains the NULL function address. The null function address is an implementor-defined value that is guaranteed not to represent the address of any function.' The value is the NULL NAME - FunctionPointer.Null, the struct default - and the guarantee holds because no FUNCTION-ID paragraph can name a function null, so no registered function can ever compare equal to it. It is also the item's initial state (PicInfo.DefaultInitializer) and the INITIALIZE SET-NULL target (14.9.20.4 GR4/GR6c). Witnessed at both polarities by the 2014 golden's NULL1/NOTNULL3 pair and by the 2023 golden's B-NULL. NOTE THE CLAUSE: this is GR2, not the GR3 that the PROGRAM twin takes - the first draft of this landing inherited GR3 from ProgramPointer.cs and audit_doc_citations caught it.
